depot.cannot_turn: {vehicle}: ayikwazi ukujikela emizileni ku-{angle}° ngisho nangomgwaqo wangaphakathi ongu-40 m.
depot.draw_zone: Dweba indawo yokupaka noma yokushaja ukuze ukuhlela okuzenzakalelayo kuyigcwalise.
depot.lane.no_aisle_entry: Awukho umgwaqo wangaphakathi phambi kokungena komzila.
depot.lane.no_aisle_exit: Awukho umgwaqo wangaphakathi phambi kokuphuma komzila.
depot.lane.no_room_in: Ukujikela emzileni akungeni: umzila mfushane kakhulu ukuthi kujikwe.
depot.lane.obstacle_in: Uma ingena, imoto ingathinta imoto epakiwe.
depot.lane.obstacle_out: Uma iphuma, imoto ingathinta imoto epakiwe.
depot.lane.outside_in: Uma ingena, imoto ingeqa ngaphezu kocingo lwesiteshi sokupaka.
depot.lane.outside_out: Uma iphuma, imoto ingeqa ngaphezu kocingo lwesiteshi sokupaka.
depot.lane.too_sharp: Umzila uhlangana nomgwaqo wawo wangaphakathi nge-engeli engaphezu kuka-100°.
depot.lane_dropped: Umzila o-1 ushiyiwe ngoba imoto ibingakwazi ukungena noma ukuphuma kuwo ngaphandle kokuthinta ucingo noma imoto epakiwe.
depot.lanes_dropped: Imizila engu-{count} ishiyiwe ngoba imoto ibingakwazi ukungena noma ukuphuma kuyo ngaphandle kokuthinta ucingo noma imoto epakiwe.
depot.no_charger: {group}: izimoto zebhethri ezingu-{count} zipaka ngaphandle kweshaja.
depot.no_drive_both: Ayikho indlela esuka ekungeneni iye kulo mzila, noma esuka kuwo iye ekuphumeni.
depot.no_drive_in: Ayikho indlela esuka ekungeneni iye kulo mzila.
depot.no_drive_out: Ayikho indlela esuka kulo mzila iye ekuphumeni.
depot.no_entrance: Isiteshi sokupaka asinakho ukungena: engeza isango.
depot.no_exit: Isiteshi sokupaka asinakho ukuphuma: engeza isango.
depot.no_lane_fits: Awukho umzila ongenayo: umzila ongu-{length} m ngo-{width} m onemigwaqo yangaphakathi engu-{aisle} m ezinhlangothini zombili awungeni kule ndawo.
depot.no_slot_fits: {group}: izimoto ezingu-{short} kwezingu-{count} azinasikhala esizilingayo (ubude obungu-{length} m).
depot.no_slots: Isiteshi sokupaka asinazo izikhala okwamanje: dweba izindawo bese usebenzisa ukuhlela okuzenzakalelayo.
depot.straight_drives: Ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwesiteshi sokupaka kulandela imigqa eqondile endaweni evulekile; dweba indawo yokuhamba noma ushiye isikhala eduze nocingo lapho izimoto okufanele zihambe khona.
gtfs.unknown_route_types: Izinhlobo zemizila {types} azaziwa futhi zifundwa njengebhasi.
kits.berth.conflict: Imikhumbi ilinda indawo yokumisa ku-{pier} izikhathi ezingu-{holds} emizuzwini engu-{window} (sekukonke {held}). Engeza indawo yokumisa noma ushintshe isikhala sesikhathi noma ukuphumula.
kits.capacity.ceiling: Abagibeli abangu-{capacity} ngehora ohlangothini ngalunye bangaphezu kwalokho noma iyiphi imoto yentambo ekuthwalayo (cishe {ceiling}).
kits.clearance.min: Ikhabethe eligcwele lisondela emhlabathini kuze kufike ku-{clearance}; kudingeka okungenani u-{min}.
kits.clearance.recommended: Ikhabethe eligcwele lisondela emhlabathini kuze kufike ku-{clearance}; kunconywa u-{recommended}.
kits.dwell.over_capacity: Abagibeli abangu-{pax} abagibelayo nabehlayo ekumeni okukodwa bangaphezu kwalokho umkhumbi okuthwalayo ({capacity}).
kits.ground.assumed_all: Umhlabathi ungumugqa oqondile phakathi kokuphakama kweziteshi. Ukuphakama komhlaba nokwezakhiwo akuhlolwa.
kits.ground.assumed_section: Akukho kuphakama komhlaba kule ngxenye; umhlabathi ungumugqa oqondile phakathi kokuphakama kweziteshi.
kits.route.unchecked: Umzila ulandela amaphuzu akho okudlula. Umhlaba, amabhuloho, izingodo zamanzi (locks) nokujula kwamanzi akukahlolwa.
kits.span.too_long: Isikhala {span} singu-{length}; le sistimu inesikhala esiphezulu esingu-{max}. Engeza umbhoshongo.
kits.station.angle: Ulayini ujika ngo-{angle}° lapha; le sistimu ivumela u-{max}° esiteshini.
kits.station.angle_reversible: Imoto yentambo eya ibuye (aerial tramway) ihamba iqonde; ijika ngo-{angle}° lapha. Yihlukanise ibe yimigqa emibili.
kits.station.intermediate_reversible: Izimoto zentambo eziya zibuye azivamile ukuba neziteshi phakathi kweziteshi zokugcina; womabili amakhabethe ayama uma elilodwa lima.
kits.tower.too_tall: Umbhoshongo osebangeni elingu-{at} ude ngo-{height}; imibhoshongo yale sistimu ifinyelela ku-{max} kuphela.
kits.zone.busy: Izimoto zimatasa u-{busy} % wesikhathi, ngaphezu kuka-{target} % ogcina ukulinda kufushane; kunconywa izimoto ezingu-{needed}.
kits.zone.crossing: Umngcele wendawo uyaziwela. Hambisa iphuzu ukuze umngcele uzungeze kanye.
kits.zone.draw: Chofoza okungenani amaphuzu amathathu ebalazweni ukuze udwebe umngcele wendawo.
kits.zone.fleet_short: Izimoto ezingu-{fleet} azikwazi ukuhambisana nezicelo ezingu-{requests} ngehora: kudingeka cishe ezingu-{needed}.
kits.zone.full: Izimoto zithwala abagibeli abangu-{riders} ngokwesilinganiso ezindaweni ezingu-{places}: izicelo eziningi bezingazithola zigcwele.
kits.zone.no_fleet: Beka ukuthi zingaki izimoto ezisebenza kule ndawo.
kits.zone.wait: Abagibeli balinda cishe imizuzu engu-{wait} ngokwesilinganiso, ngaphezu kwemizuzu engu-{max} enconyiwe.
noise.check.bridge: Okuphakeme ebangeni elingu-{length}: umsindo wesakhiwo sebhuloho {db} dB ({low} kuya ku-{high} dB, ama-function okudlulisa ebhuloho e-CNOSSOS-EU)
noise.check.electric_buses: Amabhasi kagesi: umsindo wokudonsa {db} dB ({low} kuya ku-{high} dB), isilinganiso esicatshangisisiwe kuze kungezwe amanani alinganisiwe
noise.check.lden_widest: Ibhendi ye-L_den engu-{threshold} ibanzi kakhulu lapha: {distance} kusuka kolayini
noise.check.no_night: Ayikho isevisi yasebusuku: ayikho ibhendi ye-L_night engu-{threshold}
noise.check.quick_estimate: Isilinganiso esisheshayo: indawo evulekile phezu komhlaba oyisicaba, ngaphandle kwezakhiwo noma isimo somhlaba (akukho kuvikela), imigqa yesevisi kuphela ngaphandle kwezimoto ezijwayelekile
noise.check.source_berth: Izikebhe echwebeni: amandla omsindo abambe indawo, awukho umthombo okwamanje: kuyakhombisa kuphela
noise.check.source_cable_car: Izimoto zentambo: amandla omsindo avela esifundweni esisodwa (Placer County gondola EIR, 2019): kuyakhombisa
noise.check.source_ferry: Izikebhe ezihambayo: amandla omsindo avela esifundweni esisodwa sezikebhe ezinkulu (ichweba laseLivorno, Fredianelli no-Nastasi 2020): kuyakhombisa
noise.check.source_small_vessel: Amabhasi asemanzini, ama-catamaran nama-hydrofoil ahambayo: amandla omsindo abambe indawo, awukho umthombo wemikhumbi emincane okwamanje: kuyakhombisa kuphela
noise.check.squeal: Ijika R {radius} ebangeni elingu-{length}: ukulungiswa kokukhala {db} dB ({low} kuya ku-{high} dB), umhubhe uyabanzi lapha
noise.check.squeal_tram: Ijika lethremu R {radius} ebangeni elingu-{length}: ukulungiswa kokukhala {db} dB ({low} kuya ku-{high} dB), umhubhe uyabanzi lapha
noise.check.switch_impact: Izishintshi ezingu-{count}: umsindo wokushaya {db} dB kusuka ku-{extent} ngaphambi kuya ku-{extent} ngemva kwesisodwa ngasinye
noise.check.switch_impact_one: Isishintshi esi-1: umsindo wokushaya {db} dB kusuka ku-{extent} ngaphambi kuya ku-{extent} ngemva kwaso
noise.check.switch_slow: Izishintshi ezingu-{count}: awukho umsindo wokushaya ngaphansi kuka-{speed} km/h (CNOSSOS-EU)
noise.check.switch_slow_one: Isishintshi esi-1: awukho umsindo wokushaya ngaphansi kuka-{speed} km/h (CNOSSOS-EU)
noise.check.underground: {length} ngaphansi komhlaba: awukho umsindo phezulu; iminyango yemihubhe ayikalingiswa
rail.alignment.radius_below_minimum: I-radius yejika engu-{radius} ingaphansi kokuncane kakhulu okungu-{minimum} kwe-{what}.
rail.alignment.radius_below_minimum_sque: I-radius yejika engu-{radius} ingaphansi kokuncane kakhulu okungu-{minimum} kwe-{what} (asikho isikhala esanele phakathi kwamaphuzu).
rail.alignment.radius_below_recommended: I-radius yejika engu-{radius} ingaphansi kwenconyiwe engu-{recommended}; izitimela zehlela ku-{speed} lapha.
rail.alignment.ramp_not_clear: Abukho ubude obanele obuvulekile bokusuka ku-{from} kuya ku-{to}: irempu idinga u-{ramp} ngomthambeko ka-{gradient}, kodwa u-{clear} kuphela ongenazo izishintshi ({start} kuya ku-{end} ebudeni bukajantshi). Hambisa ishintshi noma welule ujantshi.
rail.alignment.ramp_too_long: Abukho ubude obanele bokusuka ku-{from} kuya ku-{to}: irempu idinga u-{ramp} ngomthambeko ka-{gradient} namajika aqondile angu-{vertical_radius}, kodwa ujantshi ubude bawo bungu-{length} (kushoda u-{short}). Yelula ujantshi noma uhambise ushintsho lwezinga luye esiteshini esikude kakhulu.
rail.alignment.ramps_overlap: Izinguquko ezimbili zezinga ziyangqubuzana (amarempu angu-{first} no-{second}). Qhelelanisa amaphuzu kakhulu.
rail.alignment.turn_too_sharp: Ukujika kubukhali kakhulu ukuthi kungene ijika. Hambisa iphuzu noma wengeze elinye.
rail.crossing.diamond: Impambano eyidayimane ku-{angle}, izinga: {level}: ujantshi ababili babelana ngocezu olulodwa lukajantshi.
rail.crossing.diamond_too_flat: Impambano eyidayimane iyisicaba kakhulu ({angle}). Idayimane elithe ukuba yisicaba kakhulu kukhathalogi lingu-{ratio}.
rail.crossing.flat_high_speed: Impambano esezingeni elifanayo nojantshi wesivinini esiphezulu. Yenza ujantshi owodwa udlule phezulu (flyover) noma ngaphansi (dive-under).
rail.crossing.gauges_differ: {mode} ({gauge} mm) no-{other} ({other_gauge} mm) bayawelana ezingeni elilodwa ngobubanzi bukajantshi obuhlukile: idayimane lidinga i-frog ekhethekile yobubanzi ngabunye nesivinini esiphansi phezu kwalo.
rail.crossing.overhead_systems: Izintambo ezingenhla ze-{mode} ({supply}) ne-{other} ({other_supply}) ziyawelana: impambano idinga ukuwelana okuvikelwe ugesi kwezintambo zokuthinta nesigaba esingenagesi (neutral section).
rail.crossing.ramp_same_height: Ujantshi ababili bayawelana erempini ekuphakameni okufanayo. Shintsha izinga likajantshi owodwa.
rail.crossing.shared_diamond: {mode} no-{other} bayawelana ku-{angle}, izinga: {level}: idayimane elilodwa elabelwanayo elinama-sleeper ngaphansi kojantshi bawo womabili amasistimu. Isitimela esisodwa kuphela ngesikhathi esingalisebenzisa, kunoma yimuphi ulayini.
rail.design.all_ok: Awekho amakhona abukhali noma ukuxhumana okungenakwenzeka: wonke amajika ahlangabezana ne-radius encane kakhulu, wonke amashintshi ayizinto zekhathalogi kujantshi oqondile, lonke ushintsho lwezinga lunerempu engaphakathi komthambeko ophezulu.
rail.existing.gauge_differs: {track} uhlangana nalokhu: {existing}, kodwa ububanzi bawo ({gauge}) buhlukile kobukajantshi okhona ({existing_gauge}). Izitimela azikwazi ukuhamba zisuka kolunye ziye kolunye: sebenzisa ububanzi obukhona, ujantshi wobubanzi obubili, noma ugcine olayini behlukene.
rail.existing.join_angle: {track} uhlangana nalokhu: {existing}, ku-{angle}. Ishintshi lishiya ujantshi okhona ngamadigri ambalwa: dweba ujantshi omusha ukuze uhambe eceleni kokhona lapho uhlangana khona.
rail.existing.joins: {track} uhlangana nalokhu: {existing}; ishintshi elisha lifakwa kujantshi okhona lapho.
rail.existing.level_crossing: Lo jantshi uwela lokhu: {existing}, ezingeni elifanayo, ku-{angle}. Lokho kudinga impambano eyidayimane eyakhelwe kujantshi okhona kanye ne-interlocking ehlanganyelwe nomqhubi wawo. Dlulisa ujantshi omusha phezulu noma ngaphansi kwawo.
rail.existing.on_top: Lo jantshi ulele phezu kwalokhu: {existing}, ubude obungu-{length}. Ujantshi usuvele ukhona: hlanganisa nojantshi okhona esikhundleni sokuwudweba futhi, noma uhambise ujantshi omusha eceleni kwawo.
rail.existing.other_system: {track} uhlangana nalokhu: {existing}, uhlelo lukajantshi oluhlukile (ujantshi we-{mode} uhlangana ne-{existing_mode}). Ukuhamba kuqhubeke kudinga izimoto ezakhelwe kokubili, njengama-tram-train, namapulatifomu namasiginali afanayo.
rail.existing.power_differs: {track} uhlangana nalokhu: {existing}, okuyi-{power}, ngokungafani nalo jantshi. Izitimela ezidlula zidinga ukushintsha uhlelo lukagesi (izimoto zamasistimu amabili noma zebhethri), futhi ukuhlangana kudinga isigaba sokuhlukanisa amasistimu.
rail.existing.tram_crossing: Lo jantshi uwela lokhu: {existing}, ezingeni elifanayo, ku-{angle}: impambano eyidayimane ifakwa kujantshi okhona.
rail.plan.cannot_move: {run}: isitimela asikwazi ukunyakaza ku-{position} (amandla okudonsa amancane kakhulu kulo mthambeko?)
rail.plan.cannot_move_here: isitimela asikwazi ukunyakaza ku-{position} (amandla okudonsa amancane kakhulu kulo mthambeko?)
rail.plan.cannot_run_outbound: Ujantshi uhlanganisa izitobhi ohlangothini lolayini, kodwa izitimela azikwazi ukuhamba kuwo: {reason}.
rail.plan.cannot_run_return: Ujantshi uhlanganisa izitobhi ohlangothini lokubuya, kodwa izitimela azikwazi ukuhamba kuwo: {reason}.
rail.plan.cannot_wait: isitimela asikwazi ukulinda epulatifomini yaso isikhathi eside kangako
rail.plan.leaves_earlier: {run} isuka ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngo-{by} ukuze ingangqubuzani nesinye isitimela.
rail.plan.leaves_later: {run} isuka kamuva ngo-{by} ukuze ingangqubuzani nesinye isitimela.
rail.plan.next_train_late: isitimela esilandelayo ku-{track} asibuyeli lapho ngesikhathi
rail.plan.no_free_train: Asikho isitimela esasikhululekile ukuqala olunye uhambo: izitimela azikwazi ukuphenduka esiteshini sokugcina esishiwo ngenhla, noma amapulatifomu aso agcwele. Engeza isiwela (crossover) ngaphambi kwesiteshi sokugcina ukuze izitimela zifinyelele epulatifomini yokusuka, noma ujantshi wokugcina izitimela oxhunywe kuso; ujantshi wokugcina ofinyelela kuphela epulatifomini yokufika awusizi.
rail.plan.no_overnight_from_siding: akukho jantshi wokulala izitimela onesikhala ofinyelelekayo kusuka kujantshi oseceleni wesiteshi sokugcina
rail.plan.no_run_built: akukho hambo olungakhiwa kusuka ku-{track} kuya ku-{to}
rail.plan.no_slot: asikho isikhala esingenakho ukungqubuzana ngaphakathi kuka-{shift}
rail.plan.no_stabling_reaches: akukho jantshi wokumisa izitimela ofinyelela epulatifomini yokuqala ekhululekile
rail.plan.no_stabling_reaches_at: akukho jantshi wokumisa izitimela ofinyelela epulatifomini yokuqala ekhululekile e-{station}
rail.plan.no_stabling_room: akukho jantshi wokumisa izitimela onesikhala ofinyelelekayo
rail.plan.no_storage_reaches: Akukho jantshi wokugcina izitimela ofinyelela ku-{stations}: izitimela zolayini zingalala kuphela emapulatifomini eziteshi zokugcina, ngakho usebenza ngezitimela ezimbalwa. Xhuma ujantshi wokugcina izitimela nolayini ngesishintshi ezinhlangothini zombili, noma uhlole amasiginali aphakathi kwawo.
rail.plan.no_track_outbound: Akukho jantshi oxhuma izitobhi ohlangothini lolayini. Hlola ukuthi iziteshi zixhunywe ngojantshi ngokulandelana kwezitobhi.
rail.plan.no_track_return: Akukho jantshi oxhuma izitobhi ohlangothini lokubuya. Hlola ukuthi iziteshi zixhunywe ngojantshi ngokulandelana kwezitobhi.
rail.plan.no_train_for_siding: akukho jantshi wokulala izitimela onesitimela esingalethwa ngesikhathi kujantshi oseceleni wesiteshi sokugcina {track}
rail.plan.no_way_on: isitimela esisuka ku-{track} sifika ku-{to} singenayo indlela yokuqhubeka ukuze siqale uhambo
rail.plan.platform_changes: E-{station}, uhambo olungu-{count} lusebenzise enye ipulatifomu kunejwayelekile.
rail.plan.platform_changes_one: E-{station}, uhambo olu-1 lusebenzise enye ipulatifomu kunejwayelekile.
rail.plan.shifted: Ukusuka okungu-{count} kususwe ezikhathini ezilinganayo zewashi ukuze kungangqubuzani nezinye izitimela.
rail.plan.shifted_one: Ukusuka oku-1 kususwe ezikhathini ezilinganayo zewashi ukuze kungangqubuzani nezinye izitimela.
rail.plan.stalls_after: isitimela siyama emthambekweni onomqansa kakhulu kuso ngemva kuka-{from}, cishe ngo-{distance} ngemva kuka-{from}. Ukuhlolwa kukajantshi kuxwayisa lapho ujantshi unomqansa ongaphezu kokuphezulu: shintsha izinga lapho, noma ukuphakama kwesiteshi nokukajantshi
rail.plan.stalls_between: isitimela siyama emthambekweni onomqansa kakhulu kuso phakathi kuka-{from} no-{to}, cishe ngo-{distance} ngemva kuka-{from}. Ukuhlolwa kukajantshi kuxwayisa lapho ujantshi unomqansa ongaphezu kokuphezulu: shintsha izinga lapho, noma ukuphakama kwesiteshi nokukajantshi
rail.plan.storage_full: wonke ujantshi wokugcina izitimela uyasetshenziswa ({tracks}): engeza ujantshi wokugcina, noma ujantshi oseceleni esiteshini sokugcina
rail.plan.storage_full_at: wonke ujantshi wokugcina izitimela uyasetshenziswa ({tracks}): engeza ujantshi wokugcina, noma ujantshi oseceleni e-{station}
rail.plan.storage_no_exit_signal: {track}: ayikho isiginali yokuphuma, ngakho izitimela zakhona azikwazi ukuphuma. Isiginali lapho kuphunywa khona (phambi kwesishintshi esixhuma nolayini) iyazikhipha.
rail.plan.trains_in_the_way: Izitimela ziyaphazamisana kujantshi. Iziwela (crossovers) eduze neziteshi zokugcina zivumela izitimela ukuthi ziphenduke ngaphandle kokuvimba omunye ujantshi; uma kungenjalo yehlisa ukuvama kwezitimela.
rail.plan.way_out_taken: indlela yokuphuma ku-{place} ithathiwe ngesikhathi sokusuka
rail.signal.inside_area: Isiginali {signal} imi ngaphakathi kwalokhu: {area}. Isitimela esimile kuyo sivimba lokhu ({area}) kuzo zonke ezinye izitimela. Yihambise emaphethelweni, ngaphambi kwakho.
rail.signal.line_of_sight: Amathremu ashayelwa ngokubona, ngakho isiginali {signal} ayiwavumeli ukulandelana eduze kakhulu. Idingeka kuphela phambi kwezishintshi nezimpambano.
rail.signal.next_too_close: Isiginali elandelayo ingu-{distance} kuphela ngale kwesiginali {signal}, okungaphansi kuka-{braking} isitimela esikudingayo ukuma sisuka ku-{speed}. Isitimela esidlula isiginali {signal} asikwazi ukuma kweyelandelayo uma ibonisa ukuma. Ziqhelelanise, noma uyimemezele ngesiginali yesexwayiso (distant signal).
rail.signal.not_main: Isiginali {signal} ivikela lokhu: {area}, kodwa ayisona isiginali enkulu, ngakho ayikwazi ukusetha umzila ongena lapho. Yenze ibe yisiginali enkulu.
rail.signal.off_track: Isiginali {signal} ayisekho kujantshi (ujantshi wayo, isiteshi noma ishintshi kushintshile). Yisuse, noma usethe kabusha amasiginali.
rail.signal.previous_too_close: Isiginali {signal} ingu-{distance} kuphela ngale kwesiginali engaphambi kwayo, okungaphansi kuka-{braking} isitimela esikudingayo ukuma sisuka ku-{speed}. Ziqhelelanise, noma uyimemezele ngesiginali yesexwayiso (distant signal).
rail.signal.removed_area: Ayikho isiginali phambi kwalokhu: {area}; isiginali eyenziwe lapho isusiwe. Izitimela azimiswa ngaphambi kwalokhu ({area}), ngakho esinye singangena esitimeleni esiwelayo. Setha kabusha amasiginali, noma ubeke isiginali emaphethelweni alokhu: {area}.
rail.signal.removed_block: Isiginali yesigaba isusiwe: isigaba sikhula sibe ngu-{block} lapho u-{enough} anele ku-{speed}. Izitimela kumele ziqhelelane kakhulu, ngakho zimbalwa ezingena ngehora. Setha kabusha amasiginali, noma ubeke isiginali yesigaba lapho.
rail.signal.removed_distant: Isiginali yesexwayiso (distant signal) isusiwe: izitimela azitholi sexwayiso sokuthi isiginali enkulu engaphambili ingabonisa ukuma, ngakho kumele ziyisondele kancane ngokwanele ukuze zime ngokubona. Setha kabusha amasiginali, noma ubeke isiginali yesexwayiso ebangeni lamabhuleki ngaphambi kwayo.
rail.signal.removed_speed: Isiginali yesivinini isusiwe: ukwehla kuya ku-{speed} akukhonjisiwe, ngakho umshayeli angangena kukho ngesivinini esikhulu kakhulu. Setha kabusha amasiginali, noma ubeke isiginali yesivinini lapho.
rail.signal.removed_starter: Ayikho isiginali yokusuka ekugcineni kukajantshi wepulatifomu: eyenziwe isusiwe. Izitimela azikwazi ukubanjwa epulatifomini, ngakho ulayini ongaphambili awuvikelekile. Setha kabusha amasiginali, noma ubeke isiginali enkulu ekugcineni kwepulatifomu.
rail.signal.removed_storage_exit: Ayikho isiginali lapho kuphuma khona ujantshi wokugcina izitimela: eyenziwe isusiwe. Izitimela ezigcinwe lapho azinayo isiginali yokuphuma, ngakho azikwazi ukuphuma. Setha kabusha amasiginali, noma ubeke isiginali yokushunta lapho ujantshi wokugcina uhlangana nolayini.
rail.signal.splits_line: Isiginali {signal} ihlukanisa ulayini, ngakho izitimela zingalandelana eduze futhi ziningi ezingena ngehora.
rail.signal.splits_line_blocks: Isiginali {signal} ihlukanisa ulayini ube yizigaba ezingu-{behind} no-{ahead}, ngakho izitimela zingalandelana eduze futhi ziningi ezingena ngehora.
rail.signal.train_reaches_back: Isitimela esingu-{train} esimile esiginalini {signal} sifinyelela emuva kulokhu: {area}, ngakho siyakuvimba ngesikhathi silindile. Hambisa isiginali iye phambili, noma uyisuse.
rail.slip.lost_crossing: I-slip ilahlekelwe yimpambano yayo: ujantshi owelana lapho ushintshile. Khetha i-slip futhi ohlwini lwezimpambano.
rail.slip.main_line_element: {slip} iyinto yolayini omkhulu, ngokuvamile engakhelwa ujantshi we-{mode}.
rail.slip.needs_one_level: I-slip idinga ukuthi ujantshi ababili bawelane ezingeni elilodwa.
rail.slip.needs_straight: {slip} idinga ujantshi oqondile ongu-{length} ohlangothini ngalunye lwempambano. Qhelisa amajika kuyo.
rail.slip.one_system: {slip} ihlanganisa ujantshi wohlelo lukajantshi olulodwa; lapha i-{mode} iwela i-{other}.
rail.slip.single_tracks: {slip} ihlanganisa ujantshi ababili abangabodwa. Lapho ujantshi ophindwe kabili uwelana khona, sebenzisa i-double junction noma i-crossover esikhundleni salokho.
rail.slip.turn_between: {what} ({slip}): izitimela zingaphinda zijike phakathi kukajantshi ababili lapha.
rail.slip.turn_between_speed: {what} ({slip}): izitimela zingaphinda zijike phakathi kukajantshi ababili lapha ngesivinini esifinyelela ku-{speed}.
rail.slip.wrong_angle: {slip} yakhelwe ujantshi owelana ku-{ratio} ({angle}). Lo jantshi uwelana ku-{actual_ratio} ({actual_angle}): shintsha i-engeli phakathi kwabo.
rail.station.platform_short: {station}: ipulatifomu {platform} imfushane kakhulu kwisitimela esingu-{train} kanye nokubekezelela ukuma okungu-{tolerance}.
rail.station.terminus_no_crossover_ahead: {station}: ukuphela okungaphambili kuyisiteshi sokugcina esingenayo i-crossover ekusondeleni: izitimela azikwazi ukushintsha ujantshi ukuze ziphenduke.
rail.station.terminus_no_crossover_rear: {station}: ukuphela okungemuva kuyisiteshi sokugcina esingenayo i-crossover ekusondeleni: izitimela azikwazi ukushintsha ujantshi ukuze ziphenduke.
rail.street.crosses_ramp: {name} iwela ujantshi erempini yawo, lapho ujantshi ungekho ezingeni lomgwaqo futhi ungajulile noma ungaphakeme ngokwanele ukuthi udlule ngaphansi noma phezu komgwaqo. Qhelisa irempu emgwaqweni.
rail.street.cycle_angle: {name} iwela ujantshi ku-{angle}, kuyisicaba kakhulu kuno-{limit}: isondo lebhayisikili lingangena esikhaleni eceleni kukajantshi bese umgibeli ewa. Goba indlela ukuze ihlangane nojantshi eduze ne-engeli engu-90°.
rail.street.flat_angle: {name} iwela ujantshi ku-{angle}, kuyisicaba kakhulu kuno-{limit}: impambano inde futhi abashayeli abakwazi ukubuka ebudeni bolayini. Welisa eduze ne-engeli engu-90°.
rail.street.how.barriers: izivimbo zivala umgwaqo ngo-{warning} ngaphambi kwesitimela (ngo-{distance} ngaphambi kwempambano ku-{speed})
rail.street.how.marked: impambano emakiwe enezimpawu zesexwayiso, lapho abantu beqaphela ithremu
rail.street.how.path_gates: amalambu namasango abahamba ngezinyawo noma i-maze kuvala indlela ngo-{warning} ngaphambi kwesitimela
rail.street.how.traffic_signals: amarobhothi amisa izimoto zomgwaqo ukuze kudlule ithremu
rail.street.level_crossing: Impambano yezinga no-{name} ku-{angle}: {how}. Amabhasi nezinye izimoto zomgwaqo zilinda ngo-{distance} kusuka ephuzwini lempambano futhi azilokothi zime kujantshi.
rail.street.line_speed: Isivinini solayini phezu kwempambano yezinga no-{name} singu-{speed}, ngaphezu komkhawulo ojwayelekile ongu-{limit}. Idinga izivimbo ezigcwele ezinokutholwa kwezithiyo okuxhunywe namasiginali, ukuze izitimela zime ngesikhathi impambano ingavulekile, noma isivinini esiphansi lapho.
rail.street.mode_no_crossing_path: Ujantshi we-{mode} uwela u-{name} ezingeni elifanayo. Olayini be-{mode} ngokuvamile abanazo izimpambano zezinga. Le idinga izivimbo ezigcwele, ukutholwa kwezithiyo nokuvikelwa kwesitimela okumisa izitimela ngesikhathi impambano ingavulekile. Cabanga ngebhuloho labahamba ngezinyawo noma umhubhe ongaphansi.
rail.street.mode_no_crossing_street: Ujantshi we-{mode} uwela u-{name} ezingeni elifanayo. Olayini be-{mode} ngokuvamile abanazo izimpambano zezinga. Le idinga izivimbo ezigcwele, ukutholwa kwezithiyo nokuvikelwa kwesitimela okumisa izitimela ngesikhathi impambano ingavulekile. Cabanga ngokudlulisa ujantshi ngaphansi noma phezu komgwaqo.
rail.street.motorway: {name} ngumgwaqo omkhulu onguthelawayeka, futhi imigwaqo enjalo ngokuvamile ayinazo izimpambano zezinga. Le idinga izivimbo ezigcwele kuyo yonke imizila, ukutholwa kwezithiyo nezimpawu zesexwayiso kusenesikhathi namasiginali kude ngaphambi kwempambano. Cabanga ngebhuloho.
rail.street.path_crossing: Impambano yendlela no-{name} ka-{users} ku-{angle}: {how}. Balinda ngo-{distance} kusuka ephuzwini lempambano.
rail.street.third_rail: Lo jantshi uwela u-{name} ezingeni elifanayo nojantshi wesithathu, obungaba nogesi lapho izimoto zomgwaqo nabantu bewela khona. Kudingeka isikhala kujantshi wesithathu kuyo yonke impambano (izitimela zidlula ngaphandle kwamandla) esinemiphetho evikelwe ugesi nocingo, noma intambo engenhla kule ngxenye.
rail.street.trolley_ac: Izintambo zebhasi lentambo ku-{name} azikwazi ukuwela intambo engenhla kajantshi ({system}): amabhasi entambo ehlisa izinsika zawo futhi awele ngebhethri lapha.
rail.street.trolley_dc: Izintambo zebhasi lentambo ku-{name} ziwela intambo engenhla kajantshi ({system}): lokhu kudinga ukuwelana okuvikelwe ugesi kwezintambo zebhasi lentambo nezikajantshi.
rail.street_running.cyclists_rails: Abagibeli bamabhayisikili ku-{name} bagibela ebudeni bojantshi bethremu: isondo elibambeke emseleni liyimbangela ejwayelekile yokuwa. Umzila wamabhayisikili eceleni kukajantshi (ithebhu ye-GIS) ubagcina kude nojantshi.
rail.street_running.mixed_bus_narrow: emizileni yezimoto, kwabelwana ngayo nezimoto namabhasi: umgwaqo cishe ubanzi ngo-{width} futhi umzila wethremu onemizila yomgwaqo eceleni kwawo udinga u-{needed}
rail.street_running.mixed_bus_set: emizileni yezimoto, kwabelwana ngayo nezimoto namabhasi (kusethwe kuthebhu ye-GIS)
rail.street_running.mixed_main_road: Ithremu ihamba u-{length} ebudeni buka-{name} {how}. Emgwaqweni omkhulu ithremu ibambeka ezimotweni eziminyene futhi ingavaleleka, ngakho iyaphuza (cishe u-{delay} ngaphezulu lapha ngesikhathi sokuminyana). Yinike umzila wayo, ohlukanisiwe nezimoto, kuthebhu ye-GIS (hambisa indawo yokupaka noma umzila womgwaqo), noma usebenzise amarobhothi avumela ithremu ukuthi idlule kuqala.
rail.street_running.mixed_narrow: emizileni yezimoto, kwabelwana ngayo nezimoto: umgwaqo cishe ubanzi ngo-{width} futhi umzila wethremu onemizila yomgwaqo eceleni kwawo udinga u-{needed}
rail.street_running.mixed_set: emizileni yezimoto, kwabelwana ngayo nezimoto (kusethwe kuthebhu ye-GIS)
rail.street_running.own_lane: emzileni wayo ({width}), nomzila womgwaqo ohlangothini ngalunye eceleni kwawo
rail.street_running.own_lane_separated_s: emzileni wayo, ohlukanisiwe nezimoto (kusethwe kuthebhu ye-GIS)
rail.street_running.painted_lane: Ithremu ihamba u-{length} ebudeni buka-{name} {how}. Umzila upendiwe kuphela, ngakho izimoto ezijikayo, ezipakayo nezilayishayo zisaphazamisa (cishe u-{delay} ngaphezulu lapha ngesikhathi sokuminyana); unqenqema noma indawo kajantshi ehlukile (ukuhlukanisa kuthebhu ye-GIS) kuzigcina zingaphandle.
rail.street_running.painted_lane_limited: Ithremu ihamba u-{length} ebudeni buka-{name} {how}, ngesivinini esifinyelela ku-{limit} (umkhawulo wesivinini womgwaqo). Umzila upendiwe kuphela, ngakho izimoto ezijikayo, ezipakayo nezilayishayo zisaphazamisa (cishe u-{delay} ngaphezulu lapha ngesikhathi sokuminyana); unqenqema noma indawo kajantshi ehlukile (ukuhlukanisa kuthebhu ye-GIS) kuzigcina zingaphandle.
rail.street_running.runs_along_limited: Ithremu ihamba u-{length} ebudeni buka-{name} {how}, ngesivinini esifinyelela ku-{limit} (umkhawulo wesivinini womgwaqo).
rail.street_running.stop_island: Isitobhi sethremu {stop} ku-{name} sinepulatifomu yesiqhingi phakathi nomgwaqo: abagibeli bayifinyelela bewela imizila yomgwaqo, ngakho idinga impambano yabahamba ngezinyawo enamarobhothi ekugcineni kwayo.
rail.street_running.stop_kerb: Isitobhi sethremu {stop} ku-{name}: abagibeli bagibela besuka endleleni yabahamba ngezinyawo (isitobhi sasonqenqemeni), futhi izimoto zomgwaqo zilinda ngemuva kwethremu ngesikhathi imile esitobhini.
rail.street_running.stop_platforms: Isitobhi sethremu {stop} ku-{name}: abagibeli bagibela besuka emapulatifomini aseceleni kukajantshi.
rail.switch.built_with_legs: {switch}: kwakhiwe nge-{built} ngoba imilenze ye-{chosen} ayikwazi ukuhlangana ebangeni phakathi kwamaphakathi kajantshi elingu-{spacing}.
rail.switch.built_with_scissors: {switch}: kwakhiwe nge-{built} ngoba ama-crossover amabili alandelanayo ane-{chosen} awangeni kujantshi oqondile lapha.
rail.switch.crossover_needs_double: Ama-crossover ahlanganisa ujantshi ababili bukajantshi ophindwe kabili.
rail.switch.in_spread: {name} ikulapho ujantshi usabalala khona uya emapulatifomini. Yihambise kujantshi ohambisanayo.
rail.switch.junction_needs_double: I-double junction idinga ujantshi ophindwe kabili.
rail.switch.on_curve: {name} isejikeni. Izishintshi zekhathalogi zibekwa kujantshi oqondile.
rail.switch.on_ramp: {name} isererempini. Izishintshi akufanele zibe sendaweni yokushintsha komthambeko noma ejikeni eliqondile.
rail.switch.overlap: Izishintshi ezimbili ziyangqubuzana. Hambisa elilodwa ebudeni bukajantshi.
rail.switch.too_close: {name}: ujantshi uqhelelene ngo-{spacing}, eduze kakhulu ukuthi imilenze yezishintshi zekhathalogi ihlangane. Sebenzisa ishintshi elithe ukuba yisicaba, noma wandise isikhala sikajantshi.
rail.terrain.station_height: {station} isezingeni nojantshi bayo ku-{rail} ngaphezu kolwandle; umhlaba ebudeni bayo uphakathi kuka-{low} no-{high}.
rail.terrain.station_street_falls: {height} Ezingeni lomgwaqo umhlaba wehla ngo-{fall} ebudeni besiteshi, ngakho umgwaqo osizungezile kumele ulinganiswe kabusha kuze kufike ku-{regrade}. Hambisa isiteshi siye emhlabathini oyisicaba noma usakhe siphakeme noma ngaphansi komhlaba.
rail.terrain.steep_ground: Umhlaba unomqansa ongaka lapha. Shintsha izinga (okuphakeme noma ngaphansi komhlaba) noma uhambise ujantshi ebudeni bomthambeko. Ukuphakama kuvela kumodeli yobuso, ngakho izakhiwo nezihlahla zingase zibonakale.
rail.terrain.steep_tie_in: Ingxenye yakho ivela ekuhlanganeni nesiteshi esisezingeni noma ishintshi ekugcineni kukajantshi; nika ujantshi ubude obengeziwe lapho noma uhambise isiteshi.
rail.terrain.street_track_above: Ujantshi wezinga lomgwaqo uhamba kuze kufike ku-{height} ngaphezu komhlaba ebangeni elingu-{length} ukuze uhlangane nesiteshi esisezingeni noma ishintshi ekugcineni kwawo (ukubekezelela {tolerance}). Umgwaqo kumele ulinganiswe kabusha lapha; hambisa isiteshi noma ushintshe izinga.
rail.terrain.street_track_below: Ujantshi wezinga lomgwaqo uhamba kuze kufike ku-{height} ngaphansi komhlaba ebangeni elingu-{length} ukuze uhlangane nesiteshi esisezingeni noma ishintshi ekugcineni kwawo (ukubekezelela {tolerance}). Umgwaqo kumele ulinganiswe kabusha lapha; hambisa isiteshi noma ushintshe izinga.
rail.terrain.track_climbs: Ujantshi ukhuphuka ngomthambeko ofinyelela ku-{gradient} ebangeni elingu-{length} (km {from}–{to}); okuphezulu ngu-{max}. {why}
rail.terrain.track_falls: Ujantshi wehla ngomthambeko ofinyelela ku-{gradient} ebangeni elingu-{length} (km {from}–{to}); okuphezulu ngu-{max}. {why}
rail.track.clearance: Ujantshi wemizila emibili uqhelelene ngo-{distance} kuphela; udinga okungenani u-{needed} phakathi kwamaphakathi kajantshi (uphawu lwesikhala).
rail.track.joins_other_system_station: Lo jantshi we-{mode} uhlangana nesiteshi se-{other}. Kuyizinhlelo zikajantshi ezihlukene; hlanganisa ujantshi wohlelo olulodwa, noma uwavumele awelane.
rail.track.joins_other_system_switch: Lo jantshi we-{mode} uhlangana neshintshi le-{other}. Kuyizinhlelo zikajantshi ezihlukene; hlanganisa ujantshi wohlelo olulodwa, noma uwavumele awelane.
rail.track.lost_end: Lo jantshi ulahlekelwe ukuxhumana kwawo kokugcina (isiteshi noma ujantshi waso kushintshile). Hudula ukuphela kuye ephuzwini lokuxhuma.
rail.track.lost_start: Lo jantshi ulahlekelwe ukuxhumana kwawo kokuqala (isiteshi, ujantshi waso noma ishintshi kushintshile). Wususe noma uwudwebe futhi.
rail.track.open_end: Ukuphela kukajantshi okuvulekile. Kuxhume esiteshini noma eshintshini, noma usethe ujantshi ube ngowokugcina izitimela ukuze uphele esimisini (buffer stop).
rail.track.open_start: Ukuqala kukajantshi okuvulekile. Kuxhume esiteshini noma eshintshini, noma usethe ujantshi ube ngowokugcina izitimela ukuze uphele esimisini (buffer stop).
rail.track.storage_short: {name} ithwala u-{length}, okufushane kunesitimela esisodwa esingu-{train}.
rail.track.storage_short_unnamed: Ujantshi wokugcina izitimela uthwala u-{length}, okufushane kunesitimela esisodwa esingu-{train}.
rail.track.through_station: Lo jantshi udlula esiteshini {station} ezingeni elifanayo. Wuxhume nojantshi besiteshi, noma ushintshe izinga lawo.
street.depot.no_path: Ayikho indlela evumelekile phakathi kwesiteshi sokupaka naleso siteshi sokugcina.
street.line.beyond_battery: U-{length} ngaphandle kwentambo engenhla weqa ibanga lebhethri elingu-{range}.
street.line.end_stops: Izitobhi zokugcina ezingaphezu kwezimbili. Umzila unesitobhi sokugcina esisodwa (ulayini ozungezayo) noma ezimbili (izinhlangothi ezimbili); sebenzisa iphethini yokuphenduka okufushane.
street.line.mixed_traffic: Ulayini uhamba u-{length} ezimotweni zemigwaqo emikhulu: isiminyaminya nokuvaleleka kubambezela amabhasi, cishe u-{delay} ngomjikelezo ngesikhathi sokuminyana, futhi ayaphuza. Nikeza le migwaqo umzila webhasi kuthebhu ye-GIS, ohlukaniswe nezimoto ukuze izimoto zingangeni kuwo.
street.line.mixed_traffic_along: Ulayini uhamba u-{length} ezimotweni zemigwaqo emikhulu ({streets}): isiminyaminya nokuvaleleka kubambezela amabhasi, cishe u-{delay} ngomjikelezo ngesikhathi sokuminyana, futhi ayaphuza. Nikeza le migwaqo umzila webhasi kuthebhu ye-GIS, ohlukaniswe nezimoto ukuze izimoto zingangeni kuwo.
street.line.mixed_traffic_along_more: Ulayini uhamba u-{length} ezimotweni zemigwaqo emikhulu ({streets} neminye engu-{more}): isiminyaminya nokuvaleleka kubambezela amabhasi, cishe u-{delay} ngomjikelezo ngesikhathi sokuminyana, futhi ayaphuza. Nikeza le migwaqo umzila webhasi kuthebhu ye-GIS, ohlukaniswe nezimoto ukuze izimoto zingangeni kuwo.
street.line.no_legal_path: Ayikho indlela evumelekile: imigwaqo yendlela eyodwa, ukwenqatshelwa kokujika noma imikhawulo yezimoto kuyayivimba, futhi amabhasi awavunyelwe ukuphenduka (U-turn). Hambisa iphuzu noma ubeke isitobhi sokugcina lapho imoto ingaphenduka khona (isiteshi samabhasi, indlela ezungezayo, isiyingi).
street.line.no_road_near: Awukho umgwaqo osebenzisekayo kule moto ngaphakathi kuka-{distance}.
street.line.on_battery: Uhamba u-{length} ngebhethri ngaphandle kwentambo engenhla.
street.line.red_legs: Ezinye izingxenye azikwazi ukushayelwa; bheka izingxenye ezibomvu.
street.line.turning_detour: Ukuphenduka kwengeza u-{extra} (u-{length} esikhundleni sika-{direct}). Cabanga ngokubeka isitobhi sokugcina lapho imoto ingaphenduka khona: isiteshi samabhasi, indlela yokuphenduka ezungezayo, isiyingi noma ibhulokhi engayizungeza.
street.line.two_stops: Ulayini udinga okungenani izitobhi ezimbili. Yenza amaphuzu abe yizitobhi.
street.line.wrong_side: Le ngxenye ingu-{length} esikhundleni sika-{straight} ngomugqa oqondile. Uma iphuzu elilandelayo lisengxenyeni ekude yomgwaqo ohlukanisiwe, noma emgwaqweni wendlela eyodwa ngakolunye uhlangothi, lihambise liye ohlangothini imoto ehamba ngalo.
street.line.wrong_sidewalk: Le ndlela yabahamba ngezinyawo ayikwazi ukusizwa: izimoto lapha zihamba kuphela isitobhi sisohlangothini olukude neminyango. Beka isitobhi kwenye indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo.
